# Bundled browser libraries

Pinned upstream ES modules for offline HTTP hosting. No application code is modified.

- three.js 0.160.0 (MIT): https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160
- lil-gui 0.19.2 (MIT): https://github.com/georgealways/lil-gui/tree/v0.19.2

Only the required modules and licenses are included. `manifest.json` records npm archive
URLs, original archive paths and SHA-256 hashes for each file. Preserve the module paths
and license files when updating these dependencies.
